title: Gradient descent reliably finds depth- and gate-optimal circuits for generic unitaries
abstract: arXiv:2601.03123v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: When the gate set has continuous parameters, synthesizing a unitary operator as a quantum circuit is, in principle, always possible using exact methods. However, efficiently finding depth- and gate-minimal circuits remains a major challenge. The landscape is very different for compiled unitaries, which arise from programming and typically have short circuits, as compared with generic unitaries, which use all parameters and typically require circuits of maximal size. Previous approaches based on random combinatorial search indicate a low success rate even when the circuit ansatz is nominally adequately parameterized, motivating the use of heavily overparameterized circuits. In this work, we present a gradient-based optimization framework that enables the synthesis of depth- and gate-optimal circuits for generic unitaries without overparameterization, even under restricted hardware connectivity. translated_title: 梯度下降可靠地找到通用酉算子的深度和门最优电路
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.03123v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：当门集具有连续参数时，原则上总是可以通过精确方法将酉算子合成为量子电路。然而，高效地找到深度和门数最小的电路仍然是一个重大挑战。对于编译后的酉算子（这些算子来自编程，通常具有短电路）与通用酉算子（这些算子使用所有参数，通常需要最大规模的电路）相比，其景观非常不同。基于随机组合搜索的先前方法表明，即使电路拟设名义上参数化充分，成功率也很低，这促使使用重度过参数化的电路。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于梯度的优化框架，使得能够在没有过参数化的情况下，为通用酉算子合成深度和门最优电路，即使在受限的硬件连接下也是如此。我们规定了参数最优的电路。
tldr: 提出了一种无过参数化的梯度优化框架，能够可靠地为通用酉算子合成深度和门最优的量子电路，即使在受限硬件连接下也有效。
en_tdlr: A gradient-based optimization framework enables reliable synthesis of depth- and gate-optimal quantum circuits for generic unitaries without overparameterization, even under restricted hardware connectivity.
